descriptions.cc43b_update_controls_80260144: Compute three full-width control values from the observed state, phase, optional third control, core amount equality against original zero, availability, and flag bit two. Invoke each nonnull control at virtual slot +88 in original order, preserving live pointer/core reloads after callbacks, full-width XOR values, null handling and exact ordered floating-point comparison. Partial field/vtable views; original callback return type ignored and complete interface identity/sizeof unknown. Original zero remains an unowned external.
